selection_policy: Retrospective reporting of existing observations; not a preregistered new experiment.
information_boundary: Builders saw all twenty public requirements and had construction calls; no-library generators saw the target cumulative prefix and runtime contract. Builder reference implementations and behavioral tests were withheld. This is a whole-workflow contrast, not matched total information/compute or an isolated planning effect.
unit: One final saved candidate per project, generator, task and (for plans only) builder. The baseline is counted once, not repeated across builders. No pooling across study protocols.

not_reported.reason: No no-library candidates in this cohort; cannot form the primary comparison.

openai/gpt-5.scope: Each generator is charged both library builds once across ten plan targets (two builders x five milestones). Independent scenarios; do not sum construction across generators. Actual study built the two libraries only once.

openai/gpt-oss-120b.scope: Each generator is charged both library builds once across ten plan targets (two builders x five milestones). Independent scenarios; do not sum construction across generators. Actual study built the two libraries only once.

costs.limitations: Method-selected receipts exclude unresolved historical transport reservations. Construction, failed build attempts and exposure are reported separately. Local compute and human time are unpriced. Original stage bills include archived conditions and are not rewritten.

validation_scope: Zero-API reconstruction from saved endpoint summaries with independent current-score cross-checks; not a new browser evaluation or new model generation.
